name: Valkyrie
slug: Vecna's sister, killed so her blood and skin could make the Raskina.
description: Valkyrie was Vecna's sister. He calls her very courageous and possibly one of the first shield maidens, and says her name has been watered down until people no longer hear the legend in it. She supported his studies and did the physical labor he could not, because he was not strong. He killed her, skinned her half alive, and used her blood as the ink of the Raskina. Her skin is taken to be the book's cover.
